# Remote Work Policy

Policy ID: HR-POL-019. Effective 2026-01-01.

## Eligibility

Employees who have completed their 90-day probation period are eligible for hybrid remote work.
Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week with manager approval.

## Exceptions

Fully remote arrangements require approval from a Vice President and HR. Approval is reviewed every 12 months.

## Equipment Stipend

| Item | Allowance | Frequency |
|---|---|---|
| Home office setup | $500 | One time |
| Internet reimbursement | $40 | Monthly |

Receipts must be submitted through the expense system within 30 days. See also the [IT remote access requirements](../it/remote-work-policy.md).
